pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Gunner's Senegal and Morocco have done the heavy lifting, but Bubba G, your squad is a house of cards waiting for a strong draft to blow it down.**

Let me tell you something, Bubba G: when you lean on France to carry your load and ignore the rest, you're basically handing the keys to the football kingdom over to fate — and we all know how that plays out. Devin, look at me. LOOK AT ME. You drafted Bosnia, and yet here you are, in second place. It's testament to some miracle-by-Spain strategy rather than any managerial genius. Zach, aka Mustard Boy, wake up and smell the sauerkraut! You think Brazil’s gonna do all the work? Ghana just showed you the door with a loss to Colombia, contributing zilch to your prospects. And Gayden, The Backpass Assassin, England and Japan can only drag your sorry squad so far before they decide diving into oblivion with Turkey and Jordan is less embarrassing. As for you, The Noisemaker Rafe, the fact that Germany anchors your team and yet you're still in last reeks of legendary mismanagement — even for a 15-year-old! Here's the prediction you didn't know you needed: Gunner stays on top, but not because of skill, just blind luck. Wow! What a strategy!

pundit_takes.subtitle: Zach invests heavily in style over substance, finds neither in Ghana's loss.
